name: acos-spec-engine
description: Native ACOS specification engine: structured, dependency-free spec-driven development lifecycle.

constitution.name: Constitution
constitution.description: Establish project principles, constraints, and authority boundaries before writing specifications.

specify.name: Specify
specify.description: Convert objectives into a structured spec with stories, requirements, scope, failure modes, and acceptance criteria.

clarify.name: Clarify
clarify.description: Resolve ambiguities, contradictions, and unresolved decisions in the spec before planning.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Produce a dependency-aware implementation plan grounded in repository evidence and the spec.

data-model.name: Data Model
data-model.description: Define entities, relations, invariants, and API contracts implied by the spec and plan.

checklist.name: Checklist
checklist.description: Generate quality checklists for completeness, clarity, consistency, security, and testing.

tasks.name: Tasks
tasks.description: Break the plan into actionable, tracked tasks with dependencies, estimates, and owners.

analyze.name: Analyze
analyze.description: Cross-artifact consistency analysis: spec, plan, data model, tasks, and checklist must agree.

wave-plan.name: Wave Plan
wave-plan.description: Generate a wave-config from structured tasks for parallel agent dispatch.

implement.name: Implement
implement.description: Execute the approved tasks with bounded autonomy, updating artifacts as decisions change.

review.name: Review
review.description: Post-implementation code review for bugs, security, quality, and spec coherence. Produces specs/<feature-id>/review.md.

tests.name: Tests
tests.description: Detect test framework, generate tests from acceptance criteria, and run them. Produces specs/<feature-id>/tests.md.

lint.name: Lint
lint.description: Detect linter, run it, and auto-fix fixable issues. Produces specs/<feature-id>/lint-report.md.

security.name: Security
security.description: STRIDE-driven security review of the implemented change. Produces specs/<feature-id>/security-review.md.

verify.name: Verify
verify.description: Run acceptance criteria, checklists, static checks, and tests independently from implementation.

converge.name: Converge
converge.description: Gap analysis between spec/plan/tasks and actual implementation before delivery.

ship.name: Ship
ship.description: Prepare the verified change for delivery without assuming publish authority.

featureIdRules.description: Zero-padded three-digit serial number followed by a short kebab-case name, e.g. '001-native-auth', '042-batch-import'. The same ID is used for the spec directory, branch, and worktree names.

branchAndWorktree.description: The feature ID is the canonical branch name and worktree directory name.

qualityGates.name: Completeness
checks: Every requirement has an acceptance criterion.
Every acceptance criterion has a verification method.
All known failure modes are documented.

qualityGates.name: Clarity
checks: User stories name a stakeholder and observable outcome.
No ambiguous pronouns or undefined terms in acceptance criteria.

qualityGates.name: Consistency
checks: Spec, plan, data model, tasks, and checklists do not contradict each other.
Terminology matches repository and architecture conventions.
Stable IDs and file references are correct.

qualityGates.name: Security
checks: Trust boundaries are identified for every affected surface.
Input validation, auth, and authz are covered.
No credentials or secrets are written to specs or plans.

qualityGates.name: Tests
checks: Each acceptance criterion maps to at least one test or check.
Failure-mode tests are included where practical.
Test commands are recorded and runnable.

lightweightTrack.description: A spec may substitute an approved action-plan document for plan+data-model+checklist+tasks. The spec.md MUST declare the lightweight track in its Status field and reference the substituting document. The action-plan document MUST be approved before implementation begins.
lightweightTrack.requiredDeclaration: spec.md Status field must say 'lightweight track — see [document path]'
lightweightTrack.gate: The substituting document must be committed and referenced before the implement phase.

qualityGatesNote: qualityGates are textual checks on spec.md (static, pre-implementation). They are orthogonal to the tests/security entrypoints which run executable checks on implemented code (dynamic, post-implementation).
